title: Add Plan Guidance to Agent Instructions
summary: Generated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instructions now explicitly tell agents to create and wait for an EVE Plan before non-trivial Snapshot-worthy code changes. The repository's own AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md were updated to the new managed instruction version.

risks.title: EVE record could not be completed in this dirty worktree
risks.mitigation: The repository already had unrelated uncommitted .eve/cache and snapshot files before this task, and declare_plan refused to run on that dirty tree.

decisions.title: Bumped the managed instruction block to version 3
decisions.rationale: Keeping version 2 intact lets existing exact version 2 blocks be detected as stale and upgraded by the normal instruction installer path.

validation.command: git diff --check -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md cmd/eve/instructions.go cmd/eve/instructions_test.go cmd/eve/main_test.go
